summary:
Updated implementation plan incorporating the settled T7 button system (.button .button-primary, .button-secondary, .button-small) at key interactive moments throughout the floating botanical sections and human support ecosystem:
1. 'View Herbal Pieces ->' pill button on each floating botanical spread linking directly to related shop pieces.
2. 'Explore Perennis Library ->' primary action pill on the ecosystem literature pillar.
3. 'Discover Practice Pieces ->' action on somatic movement.
4. Generates true Nigella sativa bursting seed pods, floating transparent botanicals, split environmental habitat backgrounds, and alternating living foliage.
5. Strict adherence to T7 button specs (single pill, green fill #9AA66C, 999px radius, zero square buttons on actions).
Staged exclusively in /brand-preview/.
